source_export.use: coverage frequency, media-priority, and lexical-similarity signals only

entries.taxonomy: Cardiovascular System > Lipid metabolism and atherosclerosis > Familial hypercholesterolemia > LDL-receptor-mediated endocytosis
entries.learning_objective: Connect impaired hepatic LDL-receptor endocytosis of apoB-100 particles to isolated severe LDL elevation, tendon xanthomas, and premature atherosclerosis.
entries.media_spec: Original hepatic LDL-receptor binding, endocytosis, lysosomal processing, and receptor-recycling diagram.

entries.topic: Ventricular septal defect and Eisenmenger syndrome
entries.taxonomy: Cardiovascular System > Congenital heart disease > VSD > Pulmonary vascular remodeling and shunt reversal
entries.learning_objective: Explain how chronic pulmonary overcirculation raises pulmonary vascular resistance above systemic resistance and reverses a large VSD shunt.
entries.media_spec: Original early left-to-right and late right-to-left pressure-flow schematic.

entries.taxonomy: Cardiovascular System > Congenital vascular disease > Coarctation > Intercostal collateral circulation
entries.learning_objective: Trace the subclavian-internal thoracic-intercostal collateral pathway responsible for distal perfusion and inferior rib notching.
entries.media_spec: Original arterial collateral map around a postductal coarctation.

entries.taxonomy: Renal & Urinary System > Glomerular disease > Minimal change disease > Podocyte foot-process effacement
entries.learning_objective: Recognize the normal light microscopy, negative immunofluorescence, and diffuse electron-microscopic foot-process effacement pattern.

entries.taxonomy: Renal & Urinary System > Glomerular disease > IgA nephropathy > Galactose-deficient IgA1 immune complexes
entries.learning_objective: Connect galactose-deficient IgA1, antiglycan antibodies, mesangial deposition, and synpharyngitic hematuria.

entries.taxonomy: Renal & Urinary System > Tubular acid-base disorders > Type IV RTA > Hypoaldosteronism and reduced ammonium excretion
entries.learning_objective: Explain hyperkalemic normal-anion-gap acidosis through reduced aldosterone effect, suppressed ammoniagenesis, and low urinary ammonium.

entries.taxonomy: Blood & Immune Systems > Coagulation disorders > Hemophilia A > Factor VIII and intrinsic tenase
entries.learning_objective: Interpret isolated prolonged aPTT that corrects on mixing and connect factor VIII deficiency to reduced factor X activation.

entries.taxonomy: Blood & Immune Systems > Myeloproliferative neoplasms > CML > BCR-ABL1 constitutive kinase
entries.learning_objective: Relate t(9;22) to a constitutively active BCR-ABL1 tyrosine kinase, basophilia, splenomegaly, and low LAP.

entries.taxonomy: Blood & Immune Systems > Lymphoid neoplasms > Hodgkin lymphoma > Reed-Sternberg origin and microenvironment
entries.learning_objective: Identify germinal-center B-cell origin and cytokine recruitment of the reactive inflammatory background.

entries.taxonomy: Blood & Immune Systems > Primary immunodeficiency > DiGeorge syndrome > Third and fourth pharyngeal pouch failure
entries.learning_objective: Link thymic and parathyroid hypoplasia with conotruncal disease through abnormal pouch and neural-crest development.

entries.taxonomy: Blood & Immune Systems > Primary immunodeficiency > SCID > Toxic deoxyadenosine metabolites
entries.learning_objective: Explain lymphocyte loss through dATP accumulation and ribonucleotide-reductase inhibition.

entries.taxonomy: Nervous System > Neurodegeneration > Alzheimer disease > Amyloidogenic APP processing
entries.learning_objective: Contrast alpha-secretase processing with beta/gamma-secretase generation of aggregation-prone A-beta 42.

entries.taxonomy: Nervous System > Neurodegeneration > Huntington disease > CAG expansion and paternal anticipation
entries.learning_objective: Connect paternal CAG-repeat expansion to anticipation, caudate atrophy, chorea, and behavioral change.

entries.taxonomy: Nervous System > Seizure disorders > Absence epilepsy > Thalamic T-type calcium current
entries.learning_objective: Recognize 3-Hz spike-wave seizures and the selective T-type calcium-channel action of ethosuximide.
entries.media_spec: Original EEG tracing and thalamocortical circuit.

entries.taxonomy: Multisystem > Toxicology > Organophosphates > Acetylcholinesterase phosphorylation and aging
entries.learning_objective: Distinguish atropine receptor blockade from time-sensitive pralidoxime reactivation of phosphorylated acetylcholinesterase.
entries.media_spec: Original enzyme inhibition, reactivation, and aging diagram.

entries.taxonomy: Multisystem > Toxicology > Acetaminophen > NAPQI and glutathione depletion
entries.learning_objective: Explain centrilobular injury and N-acetylcysteine rescue through glutathione restoration and NAPQI detoxification.

entries.taxonomy: Gastrointestinal System > Colorectal neoplasia > FAP > APC-beta-catenin destruction complex
entries.learning_objective: Connect APC loss to beta-catenin stabilization, Wnt target transcription, and widespread colorectal adenomas.

entries.taxonomy: Gastrointestinal System > Hepatic metabolic disease > Hemochromatosis > Hepcidin-ferroportin regulation
entries.learning_objective: Explain high transferrin saturation through inappropriately low hepcidin and persistent ferroportin-mediated iron export.

entries.taxonomy: Reproductive & Endocrine Systems > Hereditary endocrine neoplasia > MEN2 > Activating RET mutation
entries.learning_objective: Connect germline RET activation to medullary thyroid carcinoma, pheochromocytoma, and autosomal dominant inheritance.
entries.media_spec: Original RET receptor, pedigree, thyroid, and adrenal diagram.

entries.taxonomy: Reproductive & Endocrine Systems > Adrenal disorders > Addison disease > POMC-derived melanocortin signaling
entries.learning_objective: Explain hyperpigmentation through loss of cortisol feedback and increased POMC-derived ACTH/melanocortin peptides.
entries.media_spec: Original HPA feedback and melanocyte-signaling diagram.
